ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes versus 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle-fluke junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the outer lateral lobes. A low-intensity black region extends from the peduncle into the center of the fluke with irregular, feathered boundaries. A distinct dark vertical linear mark is located mid-span on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep symmetrical V-shaped notch; inner lobe boundaries meet at approximately a 55-degree angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude variations extracted along the trailing edge; predominantly smooth with minor jagged serrations visible near the median notch and the distal end of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a concave sweep trajectory toward the tips; the right lobe tip exhibits a more pronounced upward vertical curvature compared to the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of a single prominent dark vertical linear disruption located on the medial-lateral region of the right lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: The black central pigmentation exhibits a distinctive 'feathered' or 'frayed' edge where it meets the white lateral lobes.
